summary: The paper 'Cayman: Custom Accelerator Generation with Control Flow and Data Access Optimization' presents an end-to-end framework for custom accelerator generation. Despite extensive searching through GitHub (repo search, code search, author profiles, org repos) and web search, no public source code repository was found. The authors (Youwei Xiao, Yun Liang et al., Peking University) have publicly released source code for their other projects (APS at github.com/pku-liang/APS, Hector at github.com/pku-liang/Hector, Cement at github.com/pku-liang/Cement) but Cayman's code does not appear to be publicly available at this time. The paper does not contain a code availability statement or GitHub link. The paper is not a survey/position paper (no_artifact=false) — it presents a real framework and includes HLS/hardware synthesis content — but its source code is not publicly released.
